# Project overview

This report summarizes a Visium HD spatial transcriptomics analysis for the configured sample.

```{r}
#| label: load-config
source("../R/utils.R")
config <- read_config("../config/config.yaml")
config$sample
```

## Data and methods

- Platform: `r config$sample$platform`
- Tissue: `r config$sample$tissue`
- Bin size: `r config$analysis$bin_size_um` um
- Normalization: `r config$analysis$normalize_method`
- Clustering resolution: `r config$analysis$cluster_resolution`
- Deconvolution method: `r config$deconvolution$method`

## Quality control

```{r}
#| label: qc-summary
qc_path <- file.path(
  config$paths$output_dir,
  "qc",
  "qc_summary.csv"
)

if (file.exists(qc_path)) {
  read.csv(qc_path)
} else {
  "QC summary not yet generated."
}
```

## Clustering and tissue domains

```{r}
#| label: clustering-figure
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
cluster_plot <- file.path(
  config$paths$output_dir,
  "clustering",
  "spatial_clusters.png"
)

if (file.exists(cluster_plot)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(cluster_plot)
}
```

## Cell-type deconvolution

```{r}
#| label: deconvolution-figure
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
decon_plot <- file.path(
  config$paths$output_dir,
  "deconvolution",
  "rctd_dominant_celltype_map.png"
)

if (file.exists(decon_plot)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(decon_plot)
}
```

## Interpretation and limitations

- Tissue-domain annotations should be interpreted alongside histology and marker-gene expression.
- Deconvolution estimates depend on the quality and biological relevance of the single-cell reference.
- Spatial neighborhood results should be interpreted cautiously when tissue orientation, section quality, or batch effects are uncertain.
- Results should be validated experimentally before being treated as definitive biological conclusions.
